text:
Maya: FYI Orca (prospect) pushed an RFP this morning. Must-haves: private control plane in their VPC, per-route SLAs, tenant-scoped audit trails, and parity with Nautilusfeatures. Theyneed a pilot by end of Q2 (~10 weeks). We need a product + eng decision: full parity ASAP, prioritize a unique differentiator, or a staged parity-first pilot. 48h decision. @Ren @Priya @Omar

Ren: Quick context: Orca is a mid-sized trading platform. Potential ARR ~1.1M if we meet compliance and uptime asks. Procurement expects technical deliverables to match the SOW.

Priya: Important question: do we commit to managed private control plane (ours) inside their network, or hand over the control plane entirely? Their legal leaning is "customer-managed control plane" because of audits. That increases onboarding effort.

Omar: They explicitly asked for customer-managed control plane + bring-your-own-KMS + FIPS-compliant HSM integration. Also want per-tenant routing overrides (ability to bind a tenant to a model variant) and immutable audit logs.

Maya: Assume customer-managed control plane for sizing.

Ren: Engineering options (short):
- Rapid parity wrap: transplant Dedicated primitives (SLOs, logs) behind a thin config surface. Fast but not elegant; ~8-10 weeks.
- Differentiator build: ship "SmartFallback" tenant-routing (policy-driven routing, auto-fallback to cheaper variants) + quantization advisory. Longer: ~12+ weeks.
- Two-phase pilot: parity MVP for compliance + lightweight SmartFallback beta afterwards. Balanced risk and schedule.

Priya: Technical unknowns we must spike: kube/network footprint for customer-managed control plane, audit log ingestion patterns, and per-route enforcement in the runtime. Recommend a 10-day spike (1 infra, 1 runtime engineer).

Omar: For the parity MVP I propose the acceptance checklist:
- Deployable control plane helm chart + terraform for customer VPC
- Per-route SLA config surface + runtime guardrail emitting p95/p99 metrics
- Signed audit log delivery to customer S3 with SSE-KMS using their key
- Admin UI toggle for tenant routing overrides with RBAC controls
- Runbook for onboarding (compliance validation steps)

Maya: Sales constraints: Orca will want an SLA during pilot. I'm okay with a limited SLA tied to pilot traffic caps. Legal: we need explicit carve-outs for pilot telemetry and onboarding windows.

legal-bot: FYI - pilot SLAs must include mitigation timeline, data custody terms, and an acceptance window. See clause template CLA-4.

Ren: Ops note audit + KMS validation typically adds ~3 business days of per-customer verification. Also recommend we include a template SOC-style checklist to speed vendor audits.

Priya: Pricing flexibility: we can offer a pilot discount if they sign an annual committed contract after pilot success. That buys runway to finish differentiator work.

deploy-bot: Created spike ticket INF-7499 and stubbed repo: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-7499

Maya: Proposed decision: greenlight 10-day spike to validate customer-managed control plane + SLO enforcement. If spike ok, go two-phase: parity MVP for procurement + explicit roadmap to SmartFallback in 6 months. Owners: Ren (spike eng), Omar (solutions/compliance), Priya (deal lead), Maya (product). Decision: +48h.

Ren: I'll kick off the spike, post daily notes in #eng-runtime. Expect ~32-48h of focused work over the next 10 days.

Omar: I'll draft the pilot SOW with onboarding durations and compliance checklist for legal review.

Priya: I'll prep a commercial term sheet with pilot pricing and commit discounts, loop in legal for SLA language.

Maya: Cool. Please post quick status updates here. If anyone thinks we must do full parity immediately, flag it now. Otherwise Ill spin up the spike and assign owners. :thumbsup:
